parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Օպտիմալացված է թայվանական մանդարինի համար։ Աջակցում է խոսքում լեզուների փոխարկմանը։

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

permissions.description: {{app}} needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access

accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

languages.title: Ընտրեք լեզուները, որոնցով թելադրելու եք
languages.description: Suggested from your system's languages. While the language is Auto, models that support it only transcribe in these, so the text never comes out in a language you don't speak.
languages.later: You can change this anytime under General → Languages I speak.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

benchmark.streamResult: Streaming: {{factor}}× real-time · feed p95 {{p95}} ms, max {{max}} ms · first text after {{first}} ms of audio

latencySelector.title: Streaming latency
latencySelector.stepsHint: This model was trained at these latencies only, so the slider snaps to them. Lower shows text sooner; higher is more accurate. Applies to the next recording.

chunkSize.decrease: Decrease chunk size by one millisecond
chunkSize.increase: Increase chunk size by one millisecond
chunkSize.hint: How much audio to accumulate before each decode. Lower is more responsive but costs more compute, because the model re-reads all audio so far on every chunk. Applies to the next recording.

shortcut.title: {{app}}-ի դյուրանցումներ
shortcut.description: Կարգավորեք ստեղնային դյուրանցումները՝ խոսքից տեքստ ձայնագրումը սկսելու համար

transcribe.name: Տառադարձման դյուրանցում
transcribe.description: Ստեղնային դյուրանցումը՝ ձեր ձայնը ձայնագրելու և տառադարձելու համար։

cancel.name: Չեղարկման դյուրանցում
cancel.description: Ստեղնային դյուրանցումը՝ ընթացիկ ձայնագրումը չեղարկելու համար։

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Հետմշակման արագ ստեղն
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Ընտրովի՝ առանձին արագ ստեղն, որը միշտ կատարում է ձեր տառադարձման ԱԲ հետմշակումը։

multi_stt_transcribe.name: Multi STT Shortcut
multi_stt_transcribe.description: Keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe with multiple STT models

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value
errors.unsupportedCombo: {{combo}} can't be simulated: use at least one non-modifier key from letters, digits, space, enter, tab, esc, arrows or F1–F24

language.title: Լեզու
language.description: Ընտրեք խոսքի ճանաչման լեզուն։ «Ավտոմատ» տարբերակն ինքնուրույն կորոշի լեզուն, իսկ կոնկրետ լեզու ընտրելը կարող է բարձրացնել դրա ճանաչման ճշգրտությունը։

shortcutActivation.title: Դյուրանցման վարքագիծ
shortcutActivation.description: Ընտրեք, թե ինչպես է տառադարձման դյուրանցումը սկսում և դադարեցնում ձայնագրումը։

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Սեղմած պահեք՝ ձայնագրելու համար, կամ սեղմեք՝ փոխանջատելու համար
descriptions.push_to_talk: Ձայնագրում է, քանի դեռ սեղմած եք պահում դյուրանցումը
descriptions.toggle: Սեղմեք դյուրանցումը՝ ձայնագրումը սկսելու, և կրկին սեղմեք՝ դադարեցնելու համար

spokenLanguages.title: Languages I speak
spokenLanguages.description: While the language is Auto, models that support it only transcribe in these languages, so a short phrase can no longer come out in one you don't speak. Switching between them mid-sentence still works, and a language you pick explicitly always wins.

anyLetters.label: Allow foreign words
anyLetters.description: Names and words from other languages keep their own spelling. Off, the model only writes the letters of the languages you speak.

status.detectorMissing: This model can't tell your languages apart on its own. A small language detector (27 MB) picks between them; until it is downloaded, Auto transcribes in {{language}}.
status.oneLanguage: With this model, Auto transcribes in {{language}}: it is the only one of your languages the model supports.
status.undetectable: The detector can't identify {{languages}}, so with this model Auto transcribes in {{language}}.
status.noMatch: This model supports none of your languages; Auto transcribes in {{language}}.

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.tooltip: Կրկին սկանավորել՝ {{app}}-ից դուրս մոդելների պանակում կամ Hugging Face-ի քեշում ավելացված մոդելները գտնելու համար

models.openPluginsFolderLoaded_one: Open the architecture plugins folder ({{count}} external plugin loaded)
models.openPluginsFolderLoaded_other: Open the architecture plugins folder ({{count}} external plugins loaded)

channel.title: Մուտքային ալիք
channel.description: Ընտրեք, թե որ մուտքային ալիքից ձայնագրել։ Օգտագործեք սա, եթե ձեր աուդիո ինտերֆեյսն ունի մի քանի մուտք։

audioFeedback.label: Ձայնային արձագանք
audioFeedback.description: Հնչեցնել ձայն՝ ձայնագրումը սկսելիս և դադարեցնելիս

outputDevice.title: Ելքային սարք
outputDevice.description: Ընտրեք ձեր նախընտրած ձայնային ելքային սարքը՝ ձայնային արձագանքի համար

experimentalToggle.label: Փորձարարական հնարավորություններ
experimentalToggle.description: Միացնել փորձարարական հնարավորությունները, որոնք դեռ մշակման փուլում են։

saveRawAudio.label: Save Raw Uncompressed Audio
saveRawAudio.description: Saves recordings in their native microphone sample rate and bit depth without downsampling or silence removal.

lazyStreamClose.label: Խոսափողը բաց պահել տառադարձումների միջև
lazyStreamClose.description: Ձայնագրումը դադարեցնելուց հետո խոսափողի հոսքը բաց է պահում 30 վայրկյան՝ նվազեցնելով հաջորդական տառադարձումների ուշացումը։ Ակտիվ վիճակում կարող է վատացնել Bluetooth ձայնի որակը։

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, CUDA on Windows x86_64/Linux).

startHidden.label: Գործարկել թաքնված
startHidden.description: Գործարկել համակարգային վահանակում՝ առանց պատուհանը բացելու։

style.title: Վերադրվող պատուհան
style.description: Ընտրեք ձայնագրման վերադրվող պատուհանի տեսքը։ «Չկա»-ն թաքցնում է այն, «Նվազագույն»-ը ցուցադրում է կոմպակտ պատուհանիկ, «Ուղիղ»-ը խոսելիս իրական ժամանակում ցուցադրում է տառադարձումը (միայն հոսքային մոդելների համար — մոդելների ընտրիչում փնտրեք «Հոսքային» նշանը)։ Linux-ում առաջարկվում է «Չկա»։

position.title: Վերադրվող պատուհանի դիրք
position.description: Վերադրվող պատուհանի դիրքն էկրանին՝ ձայնագրման և տառադարձման ընթացքում։

directMode.label: Direct Streaming
directMode.description: Reveal streaming transcription character-by-character as you speak for an instant typing feel.

directSpeed.label: Direct Streaming Speed
directSpeed.description: Speed at which characters appear during direct live streaming (in characters per second).

backCorrection.label: Back Correction
backCorrection.description: Let the preview rewrite text it has already shown, retyping a correction from the last character that still matches. Off, every update lands as one block and the preview never moves backwards — steadier for a model that revises on every chunk.

pasteMethod.title: Տեղադրման եղանակ
pasteMethod.description: Ընտրեք տեքստի տեղադրման եղանակը։ «Ուղղակի»՝ նմանակում է մուտքագրումը համակարգային մուտքի միջոցով։ «Չկա»՝ բաց է թողնում տեղադրումը, թարմացնում է միայն պատմությունը/սեղմատախտակը։

directStreamingSpeed.label: Direct Streaming Speed
directStreamingSpeed.description: Speed at which characters are typed directly into the active application (in characters per second).

typingTool.title: Մուտքագրման գործիք
typingTool.description: Ընտրեք, թե Linux-ի որ մուտքագրման գործիքն օգտագործել «Ուղղակի» տեղադրման եղանակի համար։ «Ավտոմատ» տարբերակն ինքնուրույն կհայտնաբերի և կօգտագործի ձեր համակարգի համար լավագույն հասանելի գործիքը։

clipboardHandling.title: Սեղմատախտակի կառավարում
clipboardHandling.description: «Չփոփոխել սեղմատախտակը» տարբերակը պահպանում է սեղմատախտակի ընթացիկ պարունակությունը տառադարձումից հետո։ «Պատճենել սեղմատախտակում» տարբերակը տեղադրելուց հետո տառադարձման արդյունքը թողնում է սեղմատախտակում։

autoSubmit.title: Ավտոմատ ուղարկում
autoSubmit.description: Տեքստը տեղադրելուց հետո ավտոմատ ուղարկում է ստեղների ընտրված համադրությունը։ macOS-ում կիրառվում է Cmd+Enter, իսկ Windows/Linux-ում՝ Super+Enter։

translateToEnglish.label: Թարգմանել անգլերեն
translateToEnglish.description: Տառադարձման ընթացքում ավտոմատ թարգմանել խոսքն այլ լեզուներից անգլերեն։

modelUnload.title: Բեռնաթափել մոդելը
modelUnload.description: Ավտոմատ ազատել GPU/CPU հիշողությունը, երբ մոդելը չի օգտագործվել նշված ժամանակահատվածում

customWords.title: Հատուկ բառեր
customWords.description: Օգնեք աջակցվող մոդելներին ճանաչել անուններ և մասնագիտական տերմիններ։ Մոտավոր ուղղումը ներկայումս գործում է միայն A–Z տառերով և թվերով գրված բառերի համար։

noiseSuppression.title: Noise suppression (RNNoise)
noiseSuppression.description: Clean the microphone signal with RNNoise before voice detection and transcription. Helps with fans, keyboards and room hum; leave it off if your voice sounds processed or clipped. Applies immediately — use the live VAD test below to compare.

strength.label: Suppression strength
strength.description: Wet/dry mix of RNNoise's output and the untouched microphone. 100% is the suppressor alone; lower values let some of the original back in when voices start to sound processed.

vadThreshold.label: Suppression gate
vadThreshold.description: RNNoise's own speech probability below which a frame is muted entirely. Off passes everything the suppressor leaves; higher values cut more background between words.

vadGrace.label: Gate hold
vadGrace.description: How long audio keeps passing after the last frame above the gate threshold, so word endings and short pauses are not clipped.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Ձայնային ակտիվության հայտնաբերում
voiceActivityDetection.description: Ձայնագրություններից զտում է լռությունը։ Հոսքային մոդելներն օգտագործում են VAD-ի ավելի երկար պոչային հատված, իսկ VAD-ն անջատելու դեպքում ձայնագրվում է չմշակված ձայն։

speechStats.title: Speech Stats in Overlay
speechStats.description: Show live speech statistics in the recording overlay: whether you are speaking or paused, a timer that counts only while you are actually talking, and your running average words per minute. Words per minute needs a streaming-capable model, since it is measured from the live transcription.

pauseHold.label: Pause Tolerance
pauseHold.description: How long silence must last before the speech timer stops counting. Shorter gaps are treated as part of the same sentence, so the timer does not stall between words.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Հեռացնել մակաբույծ բառերը
fillerWordRemoval.description: Տառադարձումներից հեռացնում է հաճախակի հանդիպող հապաղման բառերը։ Անջատեք՝ դրանք պահելու համար։

micIdleTimeout.title: Mic Idle Timeout
micIdleTimeout.infiniteDescription: When enabled, the microphone stream stays open forever until manually closed. Disable to set a custom timeout duration.
micIdleTimeout.timeoutDescription: How long to keep the mic open after a recording stops before closing it.
micIdleTimeout.unitDescription: Seconds or minutes for the timeout value.

vadSensitivity.label: VAD Threshold
vadSensitivity.description: Speech probability a frame needs to count as speech. Lower values are more sensitive and keep quiet or distant speech (and more noise); higher values cut more background noise but may clip soft words. Default 0.50.

vadLiveTest.title: Live VAD test
vadLiveTest.description: Open the microphone and watch the detector decide frame by frame, without loading any model. Nothing is transcribed or saved. Move the VAD Threshold slider above while you talk until normal speech reads as Speech and background noise stays Silence.
vadLiveTest.hint: Talk normally, then pause. The bar should cross the marker while you talk and stay below it when you stop; the grey tick is the recent peak. Audio kept shows what a model would actually hear after smoothing.
vadLiveTest.errorStart: Could not start the VAD test: {{error}}

chineseScript.title: Չինական գիր
chineseScript.description: Մանդարինի և կանտոներենի տառադարձումները գրում է պարզեցված հիերոգլիֆներով կամ ավանդական հիերոգլիֆներով՝ ինչպես գրում են Թայվանում կամ Հոնկոնգում։ Այլ լեզուները մնում են անփոփոխ։

pasteDelay.description: Ուշացումը (միլիվայրկյաններով) տեքստը պատճենելուց հետո, նախքան տեղադրման ստեղների համադրությունն ուղարկելը։ Մեծացրեք, եթե ոչինչ չի տեղադրվում։

pasteDelayAfter.title: Տեղադրման ուշացում (հետո)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Ուշացումը (միլիվայրկյաններով) տեղադրման ստեղների համադրությունից հետո, նախքան սեղմատախտակի նախորդ պարունակությունը վերականգնելը։ Մեծացրեք, եթե տառադարձման փոխարեն տեղադրվում է սեղմատախտակի հին պարունակությունը։

holdThreshold.title: Սեղմած պահելու շեմ
holdThreshold.description: Միայն «Ավտոմատ» ռեժիմում՝ որքան ժամանակ (միլիվայրկյաններով) պետք է սեղմած պահել դյուրանցումը, որպեսզի այն համարվի պահում, այլ ոչ թե սեղմում։ Նվազեցրեք, եթե կարճ պահումներից հետո ձայնագրումը մնում է միացված, և մեծացրեք, եթե դիտավորյալ սեղմումներն ընկալվում են որպես պահում։

reliablePaste.title: Հուսալի տեղադրում (Բետա)
reliablePaste.description: Վերականգնել սեղմատախտակը միայն այն բանից հետո, երբ թիրախային հավելվածն իսկապես կարդա տառադարձումը, այլ ոչ թե ֆիքսված ուշացումից հետո։ Նախատեսված է համակարգի ծանրաբեռնվածության դեպքում սեղմատախտակի հին պարունակության տեղադրումը կանխելու համար։ Անհրաժեշտ է սեղմատախտակով տեղադրման եղանակ։ Միայն macOS և Windows։

recordingBuffer.title: Ձայնագրման լրացուցիչ բուֆեր
recordingBuffer.description: Լրացուցիչ ժամանակ (միլիվայրկյաններով), որի ընթացքում ձայնագրումը շարունակվում է ստեղնը բաց թողնելուց հետո՝ վերջին հնչյունները չկորցնելու համար։ 0 = առանց լրացուցիչ բուֆերի։

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Ստեղնաշարի ախտորոշում
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Ստուգում է՝ արդյոք ստեղնաշարի իրադարձությունները հասնում են {{app}}-ին։ Գրանցվում է միայն իրադարձությունների քանակը, և երբեք չի գրանցվում, թե որ ստեղներն եք սեղմում։
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Լսում է… մի քանի անգամ սեղմեք ձեր դյուրանցումը (օր․՝ Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input-ն արգելափակում է ստեղների իրադարձությունները — ստեղնային դյուրանցումները չեն կարող աշխատել, մինչև խնդիրը չլուծվի։
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Փոփոխիչ ստեղների իրադարձությունները հասել են, բայց ստեղների իրադարձություններ չկան — ինչ-որ բան արգելափակում է ստեղները, թեև Secure Input-ը հաղորդում է, որ անջատված է։ Խնդրում ենք հայտնել այս մասին GitHub-ում։
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Ստեղների իրադարձությունները բնականոն կերպով հասնում են {{app}}-ին։
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: Ոչ մի իրադարձություն չի գրանցվել — թեստի ընթացքում ստեղներ սեղմե՞լ եք։

filters.errorsDescription: Include error toasts in the list.
filters.warningsDescription: Include warning toasts in the list.

sessionToasts.empty: No errors or warnings this session.

appDataDirectory.description: Վայրը, որտեղ {{app}}-ն պահում է իր տվյալները

sourceCode.title: Ելակետային կոդ
sourceCode.description: Դիտել ելակետային կոդը և մասնակցել մշակմանը

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: Բարձր արտադրողականությամբ թենզորային գրադարան՝ սարքի վրա մեքենայական ուսուցման արտածման համար
ggml.details: {{app}}-ի տեղային խոսքից տեքստ փոխակերպումը կառուցված է transcribe.cpp-ի և ggml-ի վրա։ Շնորհակալություն Գեորգի Գերգանովին և մշակման մասնակիցներին՝ հրաշալի աշխատանքի համար։

rnnoise.title: RNNoise / nnnoiseless
rnnoise.details: Optional microphone noise suppression uses nnnoiseless, a Rust port of Xiph's RNNoise (BSD-3-Clause). Thanks to Jean-Marc Valin and Joe Neeman.

handy.title: Handy
handy.details: {{app}} began as a fork of Handy by CJ Pais and is distributed under the same MIT licence. Thanks to CJ Pais and the Handy contributors.

fileTranscription.description: Turn recordings into text files. Add files or whole folders, pick how they should be transcribed, and {{app}} writes a .txt or .md next to each recording or into a folder of your choice.

dropZone.title: Drop audio files or folders here, or click to browse
dropZone.subtitle: Files are queued in order; long recordings are split at quiet points automatically.

mode.title: Transcription mode
mode.description: Which pipeline each file goes through. Post-processing uses the prompt and provider from the Post Process page; Multi-STT uses the extra models and merge prompt from the Multi STT page.

post_process.label: STT + Post-process
post_process.description: Selected model, then the post-processing prompt.

multi_stt.label: Multi-STT
multi_stt.description: All Multi-STT models, merged with the merge prompt (concatenated if no prompt is set).

multi_stt_post_process.label: Multi-STT + Post-process
multi_stt_post_process.description: Multi-STT merge, then the post-processing prompt.

warnings.postProcessDisabled: Post-processing is turned off. Enable it on the Advanced page (Experimental) and configure a provider, model and prompt, or the text is saved unprocessed.
warnings.multiSttNoModels: Multi-STT is off or has no extra models selected. Only the primary model will run; set up extra models on the Multi STT page.

outputFolder.title: Output folder
outputFolder.description: Where transcripts are written. By default each transcript is saved next to its audio file with the same name.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Plain text, or Markdown with a small header (file name, mode, model, date).

overwrite.label: Overwrite existing transcripts
overwrite.description: Replace an existing transcript with the same name. When off, a -2, -3, … suffix is added instead.

subfolders.label: Include sub-folders
subfolders.description: When a folder is added, also queue the audio files inside its sub-folders.

segmentMinutes.label: Maximum segment length
segmentMinutes.description: Long recordings are transcribed in segments of at most this length, cut at the quietest point near the boundary, so a single file never holds the model for an hour at a time.

errors.noFiles: Add audio files or a folder to get started.
errors.nothingAdded: Nothing to add: no supported audio files found ({{formats}}).
errors.emptyFolder: That folder contains no supported audio files.

saveToHistory.label: Also save to History
saveToHistory.description: Add each transcribed file to History too, with its audio and the file name as its title. History cleanup never removes these.

recall.title: Recall
recall.description: Your local note vault: transcriptions, dictated notes and your own writing, filed as Markdown files you own.
recall.emptyHint: Create a note, dictate one with the microphone, or file a transcription from History.
recall.bodyPlaceholder: Write, or press Dictate to speak into the note at the cursor.

enc.title: Encryption
enc.description: Encrypt every note with a passphrase (XChaCha20-Poly1305 + Argon2id). The passphrase never leaves this device and is never stored.
enc.off: Encryption is off — the vault is plain Markdown files.
enc.passphraseHint: At least 8 characters. There is no recovery: losing the passphrase means losing the notes.
enc.encrypted: Vault encrypted — {{count}} notes are now ciphertext. No plaintext copy was kept: only your passphrase opens them.
enc.lockedHint: Enter the passphrase in the Encryption section below to read and edit the notes.
enc.disableHint: Every note will be decrypted back to plain Markdown, and the key file removed. The vault is fully decrypted before encryption turns off.
enc.decrypted: Vault decrypted — the notes are plain Markdown again.

liveMode.title: Live Mode
liveMode.description: Keep listening and record everything: the raw microphone signal is saved in chunked WAV files while the live transcription is written into a text file as you speak. Needs a streaming-capable model.

model.label: Model: {{model}}
model.notStreaming: {{model}} does not support live streaming. Pick a streaming-capable model (for example a Whisper or Parakeet GGUF) in the footer to use Live Mode.
model.none: No model selected. Pick a streaming-capable model in the footer to use Live Mode.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: The transcript appears here as you speak and is written to the file at the same time.

outputFolder.title: Output folder
outputFolder.description: Each session gets its own sub-folder (live_<date>_<time>) with the transcript and the audio chunks.

chunkMinutes.label: Chunk length
chunkMinutes.description: Target length of one audio file and one transcript segment. The next chunk starts immediately, so nothing is lost between chunks.

format.title: Transcript format
format.description: Plain text, or Markdown with a session header and one paragraph per chunk.

granularity.title: Write to file
granularity.description: How the live text grows in the file. Character by character mirrors the stream exactly, including the model's tentative tail; word by word only writes completed words.

character.label: Character by character
character.description: Mirror the live stream, tentative text included.

word.label: Word by word
word.description: Only write words once they are complete.

saveAudio.label: Save audio chunks
saveAudio.description: Write the raw microphone signal (native sample rate and bit depth) to chunk_0001.wav, chunk_0002.wav, … in the session folder.

silenceBoundary.label: Cut chunks on a pause
silenceBoundary.description: Once a chunk reaches 80 % of its length, end it on the first pause instead of exactly at the limit, so a cut never lands in the middle of a word.

sessions.title: Previous sessions
sessions.description: Session folders found in the output folder, newest first.

preview.title: Նախադիտել
preview.description: Runs a real recording of the primary model — streaming live text when it can — whose only output is the overlay itself: nothing is typed or pasted anywhere, and no audio is kept. Watch the card and change its settings while it runs; it stops when you stop it, on the cancel hotkey, and at a 10-minute cap.
preview.runningNote: Preview running — the transcription hotkeys are busy until you stop it. Changes below apply as the card re-reads its settings.

fadeMs.label: Fade duration
fadeMs.description: How long (ms) the overlay takes to fade out when hidden. Lower = snappier, higher = gentler. Set to 0 for instant hide.

cornerRadius.label: Corner radius
cornerRadius.description: Rounds the corners of the overlay window, in CSS pixels. 0 = sharp corners.

resetPosition.label: Reset position
resetPosition.description: Reset the overlay to its default position, clearing any drag-grip repositioning.

window.noManualPosition: The overlay is at its default position

overlay.hiddenNote: The overlay is off. Choose Minimal or Live above to configure what it shows.

showCircular.label: Circular spectrum
showCircular.description: A third view beside the spectrum and the waveform: the analyser's bins, with their inversion appended and prepended, are added into one symmetric signal that wraps once around a full circle — two branches at radius 1+s and 1-s, the whole figure rotated 90° so the seam sits at the side of the ring.

circularBars.label: Radial bars
circularBars.description: Draw radial bars between the inner and outer ring instead of the two loops drawn as joined lines, with the band between them filled.

circularBins.label: Circular bins
circularBins.description: How many display bins the loop has (12–240). The analyser's bins are peak-pooled down to this many, so fewer means chunkier bars.

circularGain.label: Circular gain
circularGain.description: Fixed display gain of the loop: the bins are scaled by this and clamped — never normalised dynamically, so the ring breathes with the signal instead of always filling.

circularSignalScale.label: Circular intensity
circularSignalScale.description: Multiplies the circular spectrum's signal before drawing, so the ring breathes more dramatically without changing its pixel size. 1× is neutral; higher is more pronounced.

circularFloor.label: Circular floor
circularFloor.description: Bars below this fraction of full scale are not drawn. Raise it until the room's ambient tone stops painting the ring — without a floor the loop reads as a filled disc.

circularSize.label: Circular size
circularSize.description: Side of the square circular-spectrum view, in pixels. Make it much larger than the other views — the window grows to fit.

circularBackground.label: Full-window background
circularBackground.description: Draw the circular spectrum behind the whole overlay window, as a background layer under the card, instead of as its own view.

spectrumScale.label: Spectrum size
spectrumScale.description: Scales the linear spectrum view up or down, in percent of its base size. The overlay window grows to fit.

spectrumSignalScale.label: Spectrum intensity
spectrumSignalScale.description: Multiplies the spectrum's signal before drawing, so the bars/trace read taller without changing the view's pixel width. 1× is neutral; higher is louder-looking.

waveScale.label: Waveform size
waveScale.description: Scales the raw-audio waveform view up or down, in percent of its base size. The overlay window grows to fit.

waveSignalScale.label: Waveform intensity
waveSignalScale.description: Multiplies the raw audio signal before drawing, so the trace swings taller without changing the view's pixel width. 1× is neutral; higher is taller.

waveInsideCircular.label: Waveform inside ring
waveInsideCircular.description: Draw the raw-audio waveform as a horizontal trace inside the circular spectrum's ring, instead of as its own view beside it.

circularShowInner.label: Show inner loop
circularShowInner.description: Draw the inner (negative-contracting) loop of the circular spectrum. When off, only the outer (positive-expanding) loop is visible.

scope.title: Analyser
scope.description: The picture of the microphone the overlay draws while you record: a spectrum and a trace of the raw audio, both computed with the Live FFT page's analysis settings.

showSpectrum.label: Show spectrum
showSpectrum.description: Draw the spectrum view in the overlay.

style.label: Spectrum style
style.description: Filled area, a line, or bars.

mirror.label: Mirror spectrum
mirror.description: Draw the spectrum rising from the centre line with its negative mirrored below it, so it reads like the centred waveform beside it.

peakHold.label: Peak hold
peakHold.description: Keep a slowly falling marker at each column's recent peak, as the Live FFT page's peak hold does.

showWave.label: Show waveform
showWave.description: Draw the raw audio trace in the overlay.

waveSamples.label: Waveform length
waveSamples.description: How many samples of raw audio the trace covers, at the analysed signal's rate (4096 is 85 ms at 48 kHz). Longer windows show more of the phrase and move slower.

waveTaper.label: Edge fade
waveTaper.description: Samples faded to zero at each end of the window, so the trace never starts or ends mid-swing.

gainFloor.label: Auto-gain floor
gainFloor.description: The trace is scaled to the loudest recent swing, but never below this level, so room tone is not blown up to full height.

viewWidth.label: View width
viewWidth.description: Width of each view; the pill and the overlay window grow with it.

viewHeight.label: View height
viewHeight.description: Height of the views; above 22 px the control row grows to fit.

scope.analysisNote: Scale, window, EQ, weighting, dB range, ballistics and update rate are the Live FFT page's settings.

liveFft.title: Live FFT
liveFft.description: Real-time spectrum of the microphone with a full analyser parameter set: psychoacoustic frequency scales, shelving EQ, window and equal-loudness weighting, dB references and attack/release ballistics — plus a peak-hold analyser and a waterfall.
liveFft.hotkeysNote: While the analyser runs the dictation hotkeys report "Already recording" and the cancel hotkey stops it. Nothing is transcribed or saved.

stopReason.cancelled: The analyser stopped because the recording was ended elsewhere (cancel hotkey or tray).
stopReason.window_hidden: The analyser stopped after two minutes with the window hidden, so the microphone is not held for nothing.

canvas.idle: Start the analyser to see the spectrum

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Start from a known configuration; every parameter below stays editable. The source and threading choices are kept.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Transform length, warp interpolation, Kaiser beta mode and aggregation tuned for a frame budget. Applied on top of the current settings; the output bins are kept.

spectrum.title: Spectrum

source.label: Source
source.description: Which signal is analysed: the microphone at its native rate (full bandwidth, before noise suppression) or the 16 kHz frames a model hears (after resampling and noise suppression, before the VAD).
source.processedHint: What the model hears; 8 kHz bandwidth
source.denoisedHint: RNNoise's output at full bandwidth; the untouched microphone while suppression is off

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Frequency axis of the spectrum: logarithmic, Mel, ERB, Bark, chroma (pitch classes), linear, or a Mel + Log blend.

warpInterp.label: Warp interpolation
warpInterp.description: How the linear FFT bins are resampled onto the perceptual grid. Cubic (Catmull-Rom, 4 taps) is smoother, so a 16K FFT with cubic looks like 32K with linear at half the cost.

spectrum.nyquistNote: Clamped to the Nyquist frequency of the source ({{hz}}).

outputBins.label: Output bins
outputBins.description: Size of the spectrum sent to the page per frame in Fixed mode. More bins mean finer detail and a larger frame; 1024 already exceeds the width of the display. A count above the transform's N/2+1 is interpolated.

logFloor.label: Log floor Hz
logFloor.description: Lowest frequency of the Log and Mel + Log grids.

windowMode.label: Window length mode
windowMode.description: Set the analysis window in samples or in milliseconds (independent of the sample rate).

windowSamples.label: Window samples
windowSamples.description: Analysis window in samples (3175 = 72 ms at 44.1 kHz). Longer windows resolve closer frequencies but react more slowly.

fftSize.label: Zero-pad length
fftSize.description: Transform length. The window is centred in a zero-padded frame of this size (grown to the next power of two above the window when that is larger); a longer transform interpolates the spectrum more finely. Applies only with zero-padding on.

rawBins.label: Raw FFT bins
rawBins.description: Output the transform's magnitude untouched: N/2+1 bins from DC to Nyquist on a linear axis, with no warp, interpolation or aggregation. Scale, display max, warp blend, log floor, output bins and aggregation do not apply while it is on.

outputBinsMode.label: Output bins mode
outputBinsMode.description: Fixed: the output bin count below. Auto: one output bin per FFT bin, N/2+1 of the transform actually run.

warpAggregation.label: Warp aggregation
warpAggregation.description: Where one output bin spans two or more FFT bins (the top of a log axis), combine them instead of interpolating between two: Peak keeps the loudest, so a narrow peak is never skipped; RMS averages their power. Off interpolates everywhere.

zeroPadding.label: Zero-padding
zeroPadding.description: On: the window is centred in a zero-padded transform of the zero-pad length. Off: the transform is the window length itself (rounded up to even), the cheapest option, and the zero-pad length does not apply.

eq.title: EQ
eq.description: RBJ shelving EQ applied to new samples as they arrive, stateful and in time order — before the window and the transform.

enable.label: EQ enable
enable.description: Off skips the EQ code entirely.

highCutoff.label: High cutoff Hz
highCutoff.description: Corner frequency of the high shelf.

lowCutoff.label: Low cutoff Hz
lowCutoff.description: Corner frequency of the low shelf.

amount.label: EQ blend amount
amount.description: Wet/dry blend: 0 = dry, 1 = the filtered signal, above 1 exaggerates the change.

type.label: Window type
type.description: Taper applied to the analysis window before the transform.

kaiserBeta.label: Kaiser beta
kaiserBeta.description: Higher beta lowers the side lobes and widens the main lobe.

magnitudeNorm.label: Magnitude normalization
magnitudeNorm.description: Coherent gain keeps the window's mean at 1; full scale makes a sine of amplitude 1 read 1.0.

kaiserBetaMode.label: Kaiser beta mode
kaiserBetaMode.description: Manual: the beta below. Auto: derived from the dB range floor, so the window's side lobes sit just under what the display can show.

mode.label: Loudness mode
mode.description: Linear magnitude, decibels, or decibels mapped onto 0…1 over the dB range.

dbReference.label: dB reference
dbReference.description: What 0 dB means: the loudest bin of the frame, digital full scale, or a slow peak follower.

dbRange.label: dB range floor
dbRange.description: How many dB below the reference the display floor sits.

ballistics.label: Ballistics enable
ballistics.description: Asymmetric attack / release smoothing of the spectrum over time. Off skips the code entirely.

ballisticsMode.label: Ballistics mode
ballisticsMode.description: Per-frame coefficients or time constants in milliseconds, independent of the update rate.

attackMs.label: Attack ms
attackMs.description: Time to reach 63 % of a rise.

releaseMs.label: Release ms
releaseMs.description: Time to fall 63 % of a drop.

reset.label: Reset
reset.description: Clears the ballistics, AGC and EQ state.

performance.title: Performance

async.label: Async analysis (worker thread)
async.description: On: the transform runs on its own thread and the audio thread only copies samples into a ring. Off: the transform runs inline on the audio consumer thread. Changing this restarts a running analysis.

updateRate.label: Update rate
updateRate.description: Spectrum frames per second sent to the page.

performance.note: {{app}} analyses one channel: the selected input channel or the average of all (see General → Input channel). Settings apply as soon as they change, and FFT plans are cached per size.

features.label: Spectral features
features.description: Compute the centroid, 85 % rolloff, flatness, flux, RMS level and bass / mid / high band levels from the linear spectrum with every frame, shown under the analyser. A few microseconds per frame.

voice.title: Voice detection & noise suppression
voice.description: Tune the speech detector and RNNoise while watching the spectrum. With the source set to the 16 kHz frames a model hears, the spectrum shows what noise suppression removes.

show.label: Show voice detection
show.description: Run the speech detector on the analysed signal and show its verdict frame by frame. Changing this restarts a running analysis.

voice.idle: Start the analyser to see the detector.
voice.sourceHint: The spectrum shows the untouched microphone. Analyse the signal after noise suppression to see what RNNoise removes.

server.title: Server
server.description: The llama.cpp server {{app}} supervises. It runs detached (no console window), is stopped with {{app}}, and its output is kept below.
server.useForPostProcessingDescription: Point the Custom LLM provider at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 with the alias as model, and select it. Turn post-processing on in Post Process afterwards if it is off.
server.appliedToast: Post-processing now targets the local server on port {{port}}.
server.startOnDemandDescription: When a post-processing or merge request targets this server and it is not running, start it and wait for it to be ready (up to three minutes).
server.autostartDescription: Launch the server in the background when {{app}} starts, so the first request never waits for a model load.
server.stopOnExitDescription: Off keeps the server (and the GPU memory it holds) alive after {{app}} exits.
server.logsDescription: The last 400 lines of llama-server's output.

backend.title: llama.cpp build
backend.description: Which llama-server binary runs. Install a release here (the same GitHub assets the download script fetched) or use a folder you already have.
backend.detectNone: No existing llama.cpp folder found in the usual places.
backend.preferredDescription: Asset to install: auto takes CUDA when nvidia-smi finds an NVIDIA GPU (detected: {{detected}}), otherwise CPU. CUDA installs the newest CUDA build of the release that the driver supports (driver CUDA: {{driver}}); a numbered build installs exactly that build. Channel: latest build, stable releases only, or nightly builds only.
backend.releasesDescription: The newest llama.cpp build of the selected channel from github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp (cached for ten minutes). A CUDA build is about 180 MB; the optional cudart package adds about 500 MB.
backend.installedDescription: Builds installed by {{app}} under its data folder.
backend.includeCudartFound: Off: CUDA toolkit {{version}} found at {{dir}} — it provides cudart / cuBLAS, so a CUDA build only needs its own ~180 MB.
backend.includeCudartMissing: No CUDA toolkit found (checked CUDA_PATH, every CUDA_PATH_V*, PATH and the default install folder). A CUDA build needs the ~500 MB cudart / cuBLAS package to run; turn this on before installing, or install the NVIDIA CUDA toolkit.
backend.removeRuntimeTitle: Delete the bundled cudart / cuBLAS DLLs from this install. Only safe when the CUDA toolkit is installed.
backend.includeCudartOffPath: That folder is not on PATH; {{app}} adds it for llama-server when it starts it.
backend.includeCudartNoCublas: cuBLAS was not found next to it — turn this on, the server needs cublas64 and cublasLt64 too.
backend.includeCudartMismatch: The {{build}} build loads the CUDA {{major}} runtime, which toolkit {{version}} does not provide: turn this on before installing, or choose a build that matches the toolkit.

model.title: Model files
model.description: GGUF files for the server. Files next to the chosen model are listed for the pickers; any path can be typed or browsed.
model.draftDescription: Speculative decoding draft (mtp-*.gguf). Adds --model-draft with --spec-type draft-mtp; the fastest configuration measured for the merge and clean prompts.
model.mmprojDescription: Multimodal projector. Only loaded when the toggle below is on.
model.mmprojEnabledDescription: Off saves about 1 GB of VRAM and a little speed; text post-processing does not need it.

command.title: Command line
command.description: Defaults reproduce the launch script: 8k context, all layers on the GPU, flash attention, sampling tuned for the merge/clean prompts (temp 0.05, top-p 0.35), reasoning off, MTP draft with 4 tokens.
command.previewDescription: Restart the server after changing anything here.
command.portDescription: The provider base URL is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1.
command.context_sizeDescription: Tokens of context. 8192 covers long transcripts with room for the prompt.
command.gpu_layersDescription: -1 puts every layer on the GPU.
command.top_kDescription: Sampling: keep the k most likely tokens.
command.spec_draft_n_maxDescription: Tokens the MTP draft proposes per step. 4 in the script.
command.aliasDescription: Model name the server answers to; the provider sends it as the model.
command.reasoningDescription: --reasoning on. Off is much faster and what the cleanup prompts expect.
command.attnRotDescription: Environment flag that measured +3–4 % on short prompts.
command.customArgsDescription: When not empty, replaces everything after llama-server. Use the preview above as a starting point.

liveCanvas.description: One white particle carries each character from the analyzer. The character fades in after the particle is 75% faded out. Changes apply to the next character.

speed.label: Overall speed
speed.description: Scale all three stages together. Higher values make the animation faster.

travel_ms.label: Particle travel
travel_ms.description: Time from the analyzer center to the next character, at 1× speed.

particle_fade_ms.label: Particle fade out
particle_fade_ms.description: Time for the point to expand and disappear after it arrives, at 1× speed.

character_fade_ms.label: Character fade in
character_fade_ms.description: Time for the character to become fully visible, at 1× speed.

liveCanvas.handoff: Character fade begins after {{ms}} ms, with 25% of the particle remaining.

signal_scale.label: Signal scale
signal_scale.description: Scale the circular FFT and its waveform from 0.1× to 4×. This changes only the visualizer, not recording or transcription.

liveCanvas.correctionDescription: Only changed characters fade in place. Corrections never replay particles or backspace.

correction_out_ms.label: Correction fade out
correction_out_ms.description: Time to fade the changed characters before replacing them.

correction_in_ms.label: Correction fade in
correction_in_ms.description: Time to reveal the replacement characters. These timings are independent of particle speed.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: {{app}} needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Օպերացիոն համակարգը մերժել է խոսափողից օգտվելու թույլտվությունը։ Խնդրում ենք համակարգի կարգավորումներում թույլ տալ օգտագործել խոսափողը։
micPermissionDenied.windows: Միացրեք խոսափողից օգտվելու թույլտվությունը Կարգավորումներ → Գաղտնիություն և անվտանգություն → Խոսափող բաժնում (ներառյալ աշխատասեղանի հավելվածների համար)։
micPermissionDenied.macos: Թույլ տվեք օգտագործել խոսափողը Համակարգի կարգավորումներ → Գաղտնիություն և անվտանգություն → Խոսափող բաժնում։
micPermissionDenied.linux: Թույլ տվեք օգտագործել խոսափողը ձեր համակարգի ձայնի կամ գաղտնիության կարգավորումներում։

errors.noInputDevice: Ձայնային մուտքային սարք չի հայտնաբերվել։ Խնդրում ենք միացնել խոսափող կամ ականջակալ և կրկին փորձել։
errors.postProcessFailed: Հետմշակումը չավարտվեց, ուստի տառադարձումը տեղադրվեց ինչպես կա։
errors.mergeFailed: The Multi-STT merge didn't finish, so the models' outputs were pasted one per line.
errors.gpuFallbackTitle: Running on CPU After a GPU Error
errors.gpuFallback: The GPU failed twice while transcribing, so this model now runs on the CPU, which is slower. Change a backend setting or restart the app to use the GPU again.
errors.llamaServerFailed: The llama.cpp server stopped or could not start, so post-processing and merges that use it will not run.
errors.noModelSelected: Ներբեռնեք կամ ընտրեք մոդել Կարգավորումներ > Մոդելներ բաժնում։
errors.microphoneSilent: Ձեր խոսափողից միայն լռություն է ստացվել։ Ստուգեք, որ այն անձայնացված չէ, կամ Կարգավորումներում ընտրեք այլ խոսափող։
errors.pasteBlockedElevated: Ակտիվ հավելվածն աշխատում է ադմինիստրատորի իրավունքներով, ուստի {{app}}-ն չի կարող տեքստ տեղադրել դրանում։ Կարող եք պատճենել տառադարձումը Պատմությունից։

notices.title: Notices
notices.subtitle: Problems that happened in the background. Each one clears when it next works.

theme.title: Հավելվածի թեմա
theme.description: Ընտրեք՝ {{app}}-ն հետևի համակարգի թեմային, թե մնա բաց կամ մուգ

accentColor.title: Accent Color

streamingFirst.title: Experimental Live Streaming Merge & Clean
streamingFirst.enabledLabel: Merge and clean the live text while I speak
streamingFirst.enabledDescription: Experimental. The primary model streams live and its rough text is the 1st output, forming as you speak. Every pause longer than the one below closes a chunk: the extra models re-transcribe that chunk's audio and the merge prompt rewrites it in place, so the transcript is cleaned up at your own pauses instead of being re-transcribed at the end. Needs a streaming-capable primary model and a merge prompt — without either, Multi-STT runs its normal batch path.

multi.label: Stream the other models beside the first
multi.description: Every Multi-STT slot that can stream runs beside the primary model, and each one forms its own live text as you speak. Nothing is re-transcribed at your pauses: at each pause the models' own live texts are handed to the merge prompt, and what it returns is the session's text — the text in the overlay and the text that gets pasted. Non-streaming slots are ignored and not even loaded. The pause setting below is what ends a chunk; the context setting does not apply here, since nothing is re-run. Needs a streaming-capable primary model and a merge prompt — without either, Multi-STT runs its normal batch path.
multi.note: Every model in the Secondary, Tertiary and Quaternary slots that can stream takes part; a slot whose model cannot stream is left out of the session and its model is not loaded. Two models are enough — the mode runs with however many the list holds.

debugView.label: Show the detailed view: every model's live text, and the merged result
debugView.description: The detailed view of this mode. The overlay gets one column per streaming model, each showing that model's own live text as it forms, and under them the merged-and-cleaned text of the last pause — the block labelled Merge & Cleaned, which is the session's result. A model's column appears as soon as its stream starts, so a model that is running but producing no text shows as an empty column, marked "no live text yet", rather than as no column at all. With this off, the overlay has the single block the mode normally shows: fed by the first streaming model and corrected in place every time a merge lands, which is also what gets pasted. This changes what the overlay shows, not what the mode does.

streamingFirst.pauseDescription: How long you have to stop speaking to end the chunk being spoken. Every pause this long closes one, and a chunk is the only unit here: nothing in the text (punctuation, sentence ends) decides where a chunk ends, so the text is corrected at your own pauses and nowhere else. After 60 seconds with no pause the chunk is closed anyway.
streamingFirst.contextLabel: Previous chunks re-run with the new one
streamingFirst.contextDescription: How many chunks you have already closed are handed to the extra models together with the new one. One sentence can run across many pauses — a hum, a breath, a long reasoning — and this is what lets the merge finish it and correct the chunks carrying it, in the preview and in the final text. What is re-decoded at each pause stays the same size however long the session runs, so it never grows with what you have already said. 0 hands over only the new chunk.
streamingFirst.note: Needs a streaming-capable primary model and a merge prompt; without either, Multi-STT runs as usual. The 1st slot is the streaming model's own live text. With the Ctrl+V paste method the overlay is the only live view and the finished text is pasted once when you stop; with Direct Streaming the text is typed into the app as it forms and each merge retypes the part it corrected.

transcription.title: Press the shortcut. Speak. Text appears.
transcription.summary:
Set a Transcribe shortcut in General (a fresh install has none) and choose whether it toggles recording or works while held. Pick the microphone {{app}} listens to. When you stop, the text is pasted into the app you were using; the History page keeps a copy with the audio.

The right-edge tab shows the shortcuts that are currently assigned and jumps to the control that changes them.

models.title: Choose a local model.
models.summary: Every model runs on this computer through transcribe.cpp; nothing is sent anywhere. Smaller models answer faster, larger ones make fewer mistakes, and some are English-only while others handle many languages. Models marked as streaming can show text while you are still speaking (Live overlay, Live Mode). Download from the Models page; the first download is chosen during onboarding. Quantization variants trade a little accuracy for less memory, and the benchmark next to the quantization list measures them on your machine.

advanced.title: Advanced: paste behaviour and timing.
advanced.summary: How the text reaches the target app (clipboard paste, typing, or direct streaming while you speak), whether a space or newline is appended, filler-word removal and custom words, plus the microphone idle timeout and model unload timeout that trade memory for start-up speed.

vad.title: Noise suppression, voice detection and the live test.
vad.summary: Noise suppression (RNNoise) cleans the microphone signal before anything else hears it. Voice activity detection then drops the silent frames so the model only sees speech; the VAD Threshold slider sets how sure the detector must be. Press "Test with microphone" next to the slider: talk, then pause, and move the slider until normal speech shows as Speech and background noise stays Silence. The On/Off pill in the test toggles noise suppression so you can compare. Recordings with no detected speech are never sent to a model.

postProcessing.title: Let a language model clean up the transcript.
postProcessing.summary: With post-processing on, the transcript is sent to the language model provider you configure (a local server or an online API) with a prompt you write, and the polished result is pasted instead. A dedicated hotkey always applies it; the History page shows both the raw and the polished text.
postProcessing.warning: Online providers charge per request and need an API key. Never share the key, and set a spending limit at the provider.

multiStt.title: Multi-STT: several models, one transcript.
multiStt.summary: Record once with the Multi STT shortcut and several models (up to nine) transcribe the same audio in parallel. A merge prompt with ${output}, ${output2}… placeholders lets a language model combine them; without a prompt the outputs are simply listed. Performance mode can send a keyboard shortcut to an external power-profile tool while the models run.

fileTranscription.title: Transcribe files and folders.
fileTranscription.summary: Drop audio files (WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG) or folders on the Transcribe Files page and choose a mode: plain, post-processed, Multi-STT, or both. Long files are cut at quiet points, and a .txt or .md is written next to each file or into a folder you choose.

liveMode.title: Live Mode: dictate for hours into a file.
liveMode.summary: Live Mode keeps the microphone open, saves the audio as numbered chunk files and mirrors the live transcript into a text file while you speak. It needs a streaming-capable model. The transcription hotkeys are paused while a session runs; the cancel hotkey ends the current chunk.

liveFft.title: Live FFT.
liveFft.summary: Live FFT opens the microphone and shows its spectrum in real time — bars, line or area with peak hold, plus a scrolling waterfall. The analysis parameters are grouped as Spectrum (scale, warp, window length, zero-pad length), EQ, Window & weighting, Loudness & ballistics and Performance. Presets give quick starting points, including a raw linear-magnitude preset. Nothing is transcribed or saved; the dictation hotkeys are paused while it runs and the cancel hotkey stops it.

overlay.title: The recording overlay.
overlay.summary: The Overlay page gathers the overlay's settings: style (none, minimal, live) and position, direct typing of the live text and its speed, the speech statistics, and the analyser it draws while you record. The analyser shows a spectrum and a trace of the raw microphone audio; choose which views to show, the spectrum style, how many samples the trace covers, how its ends fade, its auto-gain floor and the size of the views. The analysis itself (scale, window, EQ, weighting, dB range, ballistics, update rate) is configured on the Live FFT page and used as is.

history.title: History and Statistics.
history.summary: History lists every transcription with its audio, word count and speaking rate, and can re-run it with another mode. Statistics adds totals, streaks and latency distributions. Raw, unprocessed microphone audio can also be saved from Advanced → History.

troubleshooting.title: Something is not working.
troubleshooting.summary: Nothing happens on the hotkey: check that one is set in General and not used by another app. No text: open the Debug page (Ctrl+Shift+D) and look at recent errors and the live log. Words missing: lower the VAD Threshold or run the live test. Slow: pick a smaller model or a lighter quantization. When reporting a problem, include the log file from the Debug page and the model name.

llama.title: Local LLM: the brain behind post-processing and merging.
llama.summary: The Local LLM page runs llama.cpp for you. Install a build (CUDA, Vulkan or CPU) from the releases list or point {{app}} at a folder that already has llama-server, pick the model, its MTP draft and the optional mmproj, and press Start. The command line shown is exactly what runs. "Use for post-processing & merge" points the LLM provider at this server; with "Start when needed" on, the first post-process request starts it and waits. The status-bar brain shows Stopped / Starting / Ready / Error, next to the CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM meters.

liveCanvas.title: Live Canvas.
liveCanvas.summary: Live Canvas turns the whole window into a quiet view of a Live Mode session: a circular analyser, a microphone button and the live transcript, each character carried in from the analyser by a particle. Open it with the button at the top of the sidebar. The title bar is hidden while it is open: drag the top edge to move the window, use the minimize and maximize buttons at the top right, and press Esc or the exit button to come back. Ctrl+L clears the text on screen without touching the transcript file. This page sets the animation timings and the analyser's signal scale.
